planning_notes: Board is Arduino UNO (arduino:avr:uno) with authoritative wiring D2 vibration input, D3 button input, D13 LED output, D6 buzzer tone output, TM1637 on D4(clk)/D5(dio), and A0 water level analog input.

No explicit circuit polarity/pullup wiring was provided for D2 and D3; defaults assumed: both are active_high and use pullup where applicable (pullup=true for inputs). If hardware uses active-low outputs/pressed-low switches, SysML must invert model values accordingly; do not alter active_low handling in port definitions.
TM1637 digit segment wiring details (register/digit pins) are not provided; using catalog tm1637_number which abstracts the bus protocol and does not require segment bit mapping.

Serial reporting protocol text was not specified; chosen assumption: numeric state-code/stage_id/water_level are sufficient. If an exact fixed text like 'wash fault' is required, replace the i32 report with serial_text_output using the exact text.
Control period chosen as 10 ms as a scheduling granularity; model must implement the real wash-stage timeouts and fault persistence using elapsed_ms deltas.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Wash process confirmation button (acknowledge end alarm)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED indicator D13 (stage indicator during wash; blink during end until confirmed)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Vibration sensor signal (detect vibration / stuck-fault conditions)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Water level sensor analog voltage/current (water level anomaly detection)

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer tone for end-stage alarm (beep until button confirmation)

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: 7-segment display shows current wash stage number (进水/洗涤/甩干/结束)

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Report wash fault message when vibration absence and water level abnormality persist long enough

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Wash fault state code for wash fault reporting (format assumption; value set in model)

interfaces.name: serial_1_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Report current wash stage number when stage changes (进水/洗涤/甩干/结束)

interfaces.name: serial_1_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Current wash stage identifier displayed on TM1637

interfaces.name: serial_1_value_1
interfaces.meaning: Most recent water level sensor reading used for stage/fault decisions

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个智能洗衣流程监控系统，使用振动传感器 D2、水位传感器 A0、蜂鸣器 D6、LED D13、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和按钮 D3。系统根据振动和水位判断洗衣机处于进水、洗涤、甩干和结束四个阶段，并在数码管显示阶段编号；当检测到结束阶段时蜂鸣器鸣叫并闪烁 LED，直到用户按键确认。若长时间无振动且水位异常，则串口输出 wash fault。
